::: {.spectrum-widget .cres-frequency-widget}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof cresEnergy = Inputs.range([5, 18.6], {
  value: 18.0,
  step: 0.1,
  label: html`
    <span class="spectrum-slider-label">
      ${tex`K_0,\ \text{кэВ}`}
    </span>
  `
})

cresElectronRestEnergy = 510.99895
cresField = 1
cresNonRelFrequency = 27.99249
cresRadiatedPower = 1.2
cresLossRate = cresRadiatedPower * 6.241509e-6
cresDuration = 120

cresFrequency = energy =>
  cresNonRelFrequency / (1 + energy / cresElectronRestEnergy)

cresTimes = Array.from({length: 401}, (_, i) =>
  cresDuration * i / 400
)

cresData = cresTimes.map(time => {
  const energy = Math.max(0, cresEnergy - cresLossRate * time)
  return {
    time,
    energy,
    frequencyShift: 1e6 * (cresFrequency(energy) - cresStartFrequency)
  }
})

cresStartFrequency = cresFrequency(cresEnergy)
cresEndShift = cresData[cresData.length - 1].frequencyShift

cresPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: 1080,
  height: 290,
  marginTop: 18,
  marginRight: 30,
  marginBottom: 45,
  marginLeft: 92,
  style: {
    background: "#ffffff",
    color: "#111111",
    fontSize: "20px"
  },
  x: {
    axis: "bottom",
    label: null,
    domain: [0, cresDuration],
    ticks: 7,
    grid: true
  },
  y: {
    axis: "left",
    label: null,
    domain: [0, 1.08 * cresEndShift],
    ticks: 6,
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: value => value.toFixed(0)
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.line(cresData, {
      x: "time",
      y: "frequencyShift",
      stroke: "#4ea1ff",
      strokeWidth: 5
    }),
    Plot.dot([cresData[0]], {
      x: "time",
      y: "frequencyShift",
      r: 7,
      fill: "#ffb347"
    }),
    Plot.frame({stroke: "#111111"})
  ]
})

html`
<div class="spectrum-panel">
  <div class="spectrum-legend">
    <span>
      <i class="spectrum-swatch spectrum-swatch-massless"></i>
      циклотронный трек
    </span>
    <span>${tex`B=1\ \text{Тл}`}</span>
    <span>${tex`P\simeq1.2\ \text{фВт}`}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="spectrum-plot-row">
    <div class="spectrum-y-label">${tex`f_c-f_c(0)\;(\text{кГц})`}</div>
    <div class="spectrum-plot-host">${cresPlot}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="spectrum-x-label">${tex`t\;(\text{мкс})`}</div>
  <div class="spectrum-summary">
    <span>${tex`f_c(0)=${cresStartFrequency.toFixed(3)}\ \text{ГГц}`}</span>
    <span>${tex`\Delta K=${(1000 * cresLossRate * cresDuration).toFixed(2)}\ \text{эВ}`}</span>
    <span>потеря энергии ${tex`\Rightarrow f_c\uparrow`}</span>
  </div>
</div>`
```
:::
